    Representation-finiteness and distributive primitive-projective Hom spaces #

    A representation-finite finite-dimensional algebra has only finitely many two-sided ideals. Over an infinite field, the pencil argument makes every pair of endpoint-stable primitive-projective Hom subspaces comparable. Kupisch cyclicity then supplies transit or cotransit for every morphism, giving the complete BGRS distributive-Hom package.
